items.title_en: Monkey, In Prayagraj, Climbs On Tree With Bag Full Of Cash & Starts Showering Rs 500 Notes On Locals | Vide
items.title_zh: Prayagraj 的猴子带着装满现金的袋子爬上树，开始给当地人洗澡 500 卢比纸币维迪
items.summary_en: A monkey in Prayagraj stunned locals by snatching a bag, tearing apart a bundle of Rs 500 notes on a tree, and causing a viral sensation after ABP News shared the video online.
items.summary_zh: Prayagraj 的一只猴子抢走了一个袋子，撕碎了树上的一捆 500 卢比纸币，震惊了当地人，ABP 新闻在网上分享了这段视频后，引起了病毒式的轰动。
